lines: וְכֹחַ יִתֵּן לָנוּ אֲשֶׁר אֵין־לוֹ קֵץ

review: 1:1 אֶמֶשׁ וְהַיּוֹם וְעַד־עוֹלָם — Hebrews 13:8 (יֵשׁוּעַ הַמָּשִׁיחַ הוּא הַיּוֹם אֶמֶשׁ וְגַם לְעוֹלָמִים); the hymn's whole refrain is that verse, so it is quoted.
2:1 שִׁירֵי הַנֶּצַח — 'songs of perpetuity', for أَمْجَدَ الْآيَاتِ (the noblest verses); נֶצַח carries both 'forever' and 'pre-eminence' in biblical usage.
3:3 רִפָּא הָאִשָּׁה — the woman healed by touching Him (Mark 5:29); the Arabic does not name her either.
4:1 אֶל־עֶמָּאוּס — the Emmaus road (Luke 24:13); the transliteration is the standard Hebrew one and must not be pointed as a Hebrew word.
